questions.question: What did Haggai rebuke the people for neglecting?
options: Keeping all of the feasts while wholly neglecting the poor among them
Offering up many sacrifices while secretly worshiping their idols
Rebuilding the house of the LORD while living in paneled houses
Trusting in the strength of Egypt instead of in the LORD their God
questions.answer: Rebuilding the house of the LORD while living in paneled houses

questions.question: What phrase does Haggai repeat, calling the people to reflect?
Haggai says they have sown much and harvested little because they neglected God's house.
Consider your _____: you have sown much, and harvested little.
Go up to the hills and bring wood and build the _____, that I may take pleasure in it.
